parsed.explanation: The dossier documents strong traveller-facing protections: national gender-identity discrimination coverage since 2013 with a 2024 court ruling awarding damages against a service that excluded a trans woman; a 2025 national hate-crime law covering gender identity; no criminalisation of expression; detention-standards directing placement by lived gender (one state); and documented social visibility (pride, gay-friendly city). Outing consequences are therefore largely remedial rather than punitive. Deductions: organised exclusionary campaigns and facilities/records friction are documented; subnational coverage is patchy; no prosecution/enforcement data exists for the new laws; passport/birth-certificate marker practice is unresolved in the sources; custody standards are documented for one state only. These are open questions and uneven remedies, not universal exposures, so the rating sits in Low Risk but below the 0.85–0.95 tier.
